scope: Single-batch M1-M4; bounded scoring reuse within fixed-problem contexts

versions.before_source: previous accepted scoring and E1 caching
versions.after_source: prepared task table and bounded route-distance memo in full evaluator; per-context scoring and prepared descent scores; no full-score memo

fixed_work: 4 models, 2 sources, 300 iterations, seed42, nonbinding 60s cap, 3 repeats per version, alternating serial subprocesses
quality: 32 pairs: additional 5-site scenario 50/100 customers, M1-M4, 5s, seeds42/43/44 (24); known 100-customer 10-site source, M1-M4, 15s, seeds42/43 (8). Sizes/scenarios of the same source are dependent.
limits: No optimality or significance claims; same-iteration equality does not imply same-wall-time output equality
rejected_pilot: rejected_score_memo_source, 48 fixed-work runs, exact equality but reusable models had small CPU regressions
